description:
A citizen has emailed a scanned complaint form. Your task is to transcribe this into ArkCase.

1. Open the file 'complaint_form_2025-001.pdf' located on the Desktop.
2. Log in to ArkCase (admin@dev.arkcase.com / ArkCase1234!).
3. Create a NEW Complaint case.
4. Link the Requestor to the existing person 'Eleanor Rigby'.
5. Transcribe the Subject as the Case Title.
6. Transcribe the Incident Details into the Description field.
7. Set the Incident Date to the date on the form (2025-02-14).
8. Save the case.
